reason: When I buy solar I will ask my brother-in-law and the neighbours which installer they used, not send my request to companies I don't know through a phone app. And with the dollar moving every week, written offers from strangers will not hold until I am ready to pay.
objection: Anyone can be listed on a website. My neighbour's system has had problems, and I want a man I can call at his shop and whose family I know, not a rating left by people I never met.
would_change_my_mind: If someone I trust in my family or street used it and told me the company it found did good work and kept its price.
